trigger: request rate exceeds the keyless budget
detection: SourceFetchError kind=rate_limited on status 429
impact: discovery stalls and the age window is missed
prevention: RateLimiter enforces a local token budget below the published limit
recovery: backoff and resume on the next cycle

trigger: two call sites share one limiter without coordination
detection: limiter refuses with RateLimitRefused before the wire
impact: silent over-consumption then a 429 storm
prevention: single RateLimiter instance is constructed per process and injected
recovery: refusal is returned to the caller as a provider failure not a token fact

trigger: key rotated or revoked upstream
detection: 401/403 mapped to SourceFetchError kind=auth
impact: every enrichment fails and the pipeline screens nothing
prevention: keys are optional by design; the keyless path is the supported path
recovery: fail closed - no screening decision is recorded from a failed fetch

trigger: provider ships a new response field
detection: zod passthrough accepts unknown keys without failing
impact: none if tolerated; a hard parse would halt discovery
prevention: schemas are permissive on addition and strict on the fields actually read

trigger: provider drops a field a gate reads
detection: zod parse failure or a null where a number was required
impact: gates that read the field degrade to soft risk or veto on absence
prevention: every optional field is typed nullable and every gate handles null explicitly
recovery: absence is graded as risk not asserted as a bad token

trigger: a number becomes a string upstream
detection: zod type error at parse
impact: decisions would be made on a coerced value
prevention: zod parses rather than casts; no implicit coercion is configured

trigger: provider aggregates behind the chain
detection: source age measured from the response timestamp
impact: a decision is made on a world that no longer exists
prevention: data_freshness veto rejects any snapshot older than maxSourceAgeMs
recovery: candidate is skipped this cycle and re-screened later
retry_policy: retried on the next cycle only

failure: stale cache served by the provider
trigger: upstream CDN or memoisation
detection: same payloadHash returned across cycles
impact: repeated screening of an unchanged snapshot
prevention: payloadHash is recorded on every fetch
recovery: duplicate snapshots are still stored; replay makes the repetition visible

trigger: RPC skipped or pruned a slot
detection: slot gap between successive getSlot reads
impact: age and freshness math drifts
prevention: decisions do not depend on slot continuity in observe/paper

trigger: the same mint appears in successive recent feeds
detection: candidate insert is idempotent on mint
impact: double-banking would inflate the candidate count
prevention: INSERT OR IGNORE on the candidates primary key plus an in-process seen set

trigger: a confirmed slot is reorged away
detection: commitment level and confirmation re-query
impact: a fill believed final is undone
prevention: confirmations are read at the confirmed commitment and re-resolved on restart
recovery: resolveOutstanding re-reads the chain rather than trusting local state
retry_policy: unresolved attempts are re-queried each pass

trigger: socket dropped by the provider
detection: n/a
impact: n/a
prevention: the architecture is polling-only; no websocket is opened anywhere in the tree

trigger: TCP alive but no frames delivered
detection: n/a
impact: n/a
prevention: no websocket exists; a future WSS adapter must carry its own liveness deadline

trigger: reading processed where confirmed is required
detection: commitment is a required argument with no default at the RPC boundary
impact: acting on state that may not survive
prevention: commitment is passed explicitly at every call site

trigger: NTP drift or a suspended host
detection: not detected
impact: every age and freshness gate is computed against a wrong now
prevention: intended: refuse to trade beyond a conservative skew threshold

trigger: provider mixes local and UTC or seconds and milliseconds
detection: parseUtc returns null on anything it cannot read as ISO UTC
impact: age is computed from a wrong epoch and the age window becomes meaningless
prevention: all timestamps are stored as UTC milliseconds in a single named column convention
recovery: null age fails min_token_age closed rather than passing

trigger: provider has not priced the token
detection: usdPrice typed number|null and read as null
impact: scoring terms that need price are undefined
prevention: every price read is null-guarded; absence contributes soft risk
recovery: decision proceeds without the term rather than inventing one

trigger: provider reports decimals inconsistent with the mint
detection: decodeMint reads decimals from the mint account itself
impact: every raw-amount conversion is wrong by a power of ten
prevention: on-chain decode is authoritative over provider metadata where both exist

trigger: two mints share a ticker
detection: mint address is the only identity used as a key anywhere
impact: the wrong token is traded
prevention: symbols are stored for display only and never used as a lookup key

failure: API returns HTML or an error page as JSON
trigger: upstream proxy or WAF interposes
detection: content-type check plus zod parse failure
impact: a parse of garbage would produce a phantom token
prevention: response is parsed through a schema before any field is read
recovery: SourceFetchError is raised and no snapshot is recorded

trigger: naive immediate retry across many callers
detection: limiter refusal counter climbs
impact: self-inflicted denial of service and a longer ban
prevention: exponential backoff with a 30s cap and jitter-free deterministic schedule
recovery: cycle ends early rather than retrying tightly
retry_policy: capped at the configured attempt ceiling

trigger: resolver outage or VPN change
detection: fetch throws a network error mapped to SourceFetchError kind=network
impact: total discovery outage
prevention: fail closed - no decision is recorded without data

trigger: split tunnel changes the egress path
detection: latency histogram shift and TLS errors
impact: requests silently route through an untrusted middlebox
prevention: intended: doctor records the egress IP and warns on change

trigger: Jupiter and a second source disagree on liquidity
detection: not detected - only one provider is wired
impact: a single provider is trusted without corroboration
prevention: intended: DexScreener and Helius adapters as an independent read

trigger: page size cap applied without a cursor
detection: response length equals the cap exactly
impact: part of the universe is invisible and selection is biased
prevention: record the returned count on every fetch

failure: latency spike masks a stale decision
trigger: provider slow under load
detection: latencyMs recorded on every fetch and carried into the snapshot
impact: a quote is acted on after it stopped being executable
prevention: order freshness deadline is checked at signing time not at quote time
recovery: intent expires and is not signed

trigger: creator never revoked it
detection: audit.mintAuthorityDisabled read from the provider
impact: supply can be inflated under an open position
prevention: mint_authority_disabled hard veto when requireMintAuthorityDisabled is set
recovery: candidate is rejected and the veto is stored

trigger: creator never revoked it
detection: audit.freezeAuthorityDisabled read from the provider
impact: the exit can be disabled unilaterally
prevention: freeze_authority_disabled hard veto

trigger: token owned by a program that can be replaced
detection: token_program_allowlist hard veto against a fixed allowlist
impact: arbitrary behaviour change under an open position
prevention: only the two canonical token programs are permitted

trigger: extension 12 present on the mint
detection: decodeMint walks the TLV area and names the extension
impact: a third party can move the position out of the wallet at will
prevention: extensions that can seize or strand a position are flagged as position-hostile
recovery: rejected before any quote is spent

trigger: extension 13 present
detection: decodeMint TLV walk
impact: the token cannot be sold at all
prevention: position-hostile extension flag

trigger: extension 6 sets the default state to frozen
detection: decodeMint TLV walk
impact: new holders are frozen on receipt and cannot exit
prevention: position-hostile extension flag

trigger: extension 14 present
detection: decodeMint TLV walk
impact: an arbitrary program runs on every transfer and can revert the sell
prevention: position-hostile extension flag

trigger: pausable extension present
detection: decodeMint TLV walk
impact: transfers can be halted while a position is open
prevention: position-hostile extension flag

trigger: TransferFeeConfig with a live authority
detection: decodeMint reads the ACTIVE fee for the current epoch not the pending one
impact: realised proceeds are lower than modelled
prevention: the active fee is used in cost math; a live fee authority is treated as risk
recovery: rejected or the fee is charged into the cost model

trigger: newer fee epoch scheduled to activate
detection: decodeMint distinguishes older and newer fee epochs
impact: a modelled cost is correct today and wrong tomorrow
prevention: the pending fee is decoded and available to the cost model

trigger: upstream adds a discriminant above MAX_KNOWN_EXTENSION
detection: decodeMint refuses rather than skipping the unknown TLV entry
impact: an unknown behaviour is treated as no behaviour
prevention: fail closed on any discriminant the decoder does not know

trigger: truncated or corrupt mint account
detection: decodeMint length and COption tag validation
impact: a misaligned read produces plausible garbage
prevention: every field offset is bounds-checked and every COption tag must be 0 or 1

trigger: account exists but is not initialised
detection: decodeMint checks the initialised flag
impact: decisions made about a token that does not exist yet
prevention: fail closed

failure: account owned by an unrecognised program
trigger: mint address points at something else entirely
detection: decodeMint refuses any owning program outside the two known token programs
impact: layout is interpreted under the wrong schema
prevention: program id is checked before any byte is read

failure: TLV entry claims more bytes than the account holds
trigger: crafted account data
detection: length validation against the remaining buffer
impact: out-of-bounds read or a fabricated extension
prevention: explicit bounds check on every TLV length

trigger: creator rewrites name and symbol after listing
detection: metadata is never used as a decision input
impact: a token impersonates a known asset
prevention: name symbol and description are stored for display only

trigger: name or symbol contains instruction-like text
detection: metadata never reaches a model or a shell
impact: prompt injection or command execution
prevention: no LLM is in the hot path and no metadata is interpolated into a command

failure: supply inflation during an open position
trigger: mint authority used mid-trade
detection: not detected intraposition
impact: dilution of the position value
prevention: mint authority must already be disabled at entry
recovery: exit on the normal exit rules

trigger: decimals of 0 or 18
detection: amount math is bigint end to end and parses decimals losslessly
impact: rounding error becomes a real loss
prevention: parseAmount and formatAmount round-trip across 0..18 decimals under property test

trigger: fees accumulate in token accounts
detection: not modelled
impact: realised proceeds differ from the quoted amount
prevention: the quote already reflects the fee for the routed amount
recovery: reconciliation compares realised balance change against the quote

failure: replaced program IDL or account layout
trigger: upstream program upgrade changes a layout
detection: decoder fails closed on any unexpected structure
impact: silent misinterpretation of on-chain state
prevention: layouts are decoded by hand with explicit offsets and no generated deserialiser

trigger: audit.isSus set upstream
detection: provider_sus_flag hard veto
impact: knowingly trading a flagged token
prevention: unconditional veto when the flag is true

failure: virtual or bonding-curve liquidity misread as real depth
trigger: pre-migration launchpad token
detection: provider liquidity is cross-checked against an executable round-trip quote
impact: size is chosen against depth that cannot absorb it
prevention: no position is sized without a quote that proves both directions
recovery: rejected when either leg is missing

trigger: all liquidity on the buy side
detection: exit_route_exists veto from the reverse quote
impact: a position that can be entered and not left
prevention: the sell quote is requested for exactly the amount the buy would produce

trigger: price moves outside the LP range
detection: round-trip loss measured on the actual size
impact: quoted depth exists but not at this price
prevention: round_trip_drag soft risk rises with measured loss
recovery: size is reduced or the candidate is rejected

trigger: creator pulls liquidity
detection: exit quote fails at exit time
impact: the exit disappears while the position is open
prevention: exit logic re-quotes rather than assuming the entry route still exists

trigger: LP tokens never burned or locked
detection: not directly measured
impact: liquidity can be removed at will
prevention: intended: LP mint authority and lock state read on chain

trigger: a lock contract that the creator can still unwind
detection: not measured
impact: a token appears safe and is not
prevention: intended: verify the lock program and its authority rather than a provider boolean

trigger: pool fee tier changes under load
detection: measured in the round-trip loss at quote time
impact: cost model understates the true cost
prevention: cost is measured from the quote not from a static assumption

trigger: router finds no path back to SOL
detection: tryQuote returns a null quote with no provider failure
impact: capital is stranded
prevention: exit_route_exists hard veto before entry

trigger: liquidity split across many venues
detection: routeLabels recorded per quote
impact: slippage is worse than a single-venue estimate
prevention: the quote is the source of truth for the achievable price

trigger: a small cluster trading with itself
detection: wash_tx_per_trader soft risk from transactions per distinct trader
impact: momentum is fabricated and reverses instantly
prevention: volume is discounted by trader diversity

failure: zero sell volume with heavy buying
trigger: selling is not actually possible
detection: no_sells_observed soft risk at weight 0.8
impact: honeypot
prevention: flagged when buys exceed 10 and sell volume is exactly zero

trigger: many wallets funded from one source
detection: not measured
impact: holder count overstates real distribution
prevention: intended: funder clustering over the first-buyer set

trigger: launch bundle hides true initial distribution
detection: not measured
impact: concentration looks lower than it is
prevention: intended: read the launch transaction set

trigger: dev sells their allocation
detection: dev_balance hard veto at entry when the field is present
impact: price collapses under the position
prevention: tokens whose dev balance exceeds the cap are refused

trigger: provider omits devBalancePercentage
detection: dev_balance_unavailable soft risk at 0.2
impact: absence treated as safety would admit the worst tokens
prevention: absence is graded as risk rather than asserted as either verdict

trigger: a whale exits
detection: evaluateConcentrationGate measures the on-chain top-holder share
impact: price collapses
prevention: holder_concentration hard veto above the configured share

failure: provider concentration figure counts the pool as a holder
trigger: bonding-curve token pre-migration
detection: provider_top_holders is a soft pre-filter only
impact: rejecting the entire pre-migration population
prevention: the authoritative measurement is on-chain and the provider figure never vetoes

trigger: RPC does not permit getTokenLargestAccounts
detection: holder_concentration_unavailable soft risk
impact: unmeasured concentration passes as measured
prevention: absence is graded as risk and replay excludes such rows from concentration comparison

trigger: launchpad migrates the pool mid-screen
detection: max_token_age bounds the window in which this is likely
impact: route and depth change between the quote and the fill
prevention: the strategy trades a bounded age window rather than the migration instant

trigger: provider caches pool state
detection: data_freshness veto plus a live quote at decision time
impact: size chosen against depth that no longer exists
prevention: the quote is taken at decision time and expires with the intent

trigger: provider price disagrees with the executable price
detection: round-trip quote is the only price used for sizing
impact: sizing against a price nobody will give you
prevention: usdPrice is never used to size a position

trigger: size too large for the pool
detection: priceImpactPct recorded per quote and bounded
impact: a self-inflicted loss on entry
prevention: size is capped by maxEntryLamports and by the viability floor

trigger: many holders exit simultaneously
detection: not modelled
impact: realised exit is worse than the quoted exit
prevention: exit slippage is bounded by the minimum-out floor
recovery: partial fill is refused; the order fails rather than filling badly

trigger: price rises while liquidity falls
detection: liquidity_diverging soft risk at 0.7
impact: the exit thins exactly as the position becomes worth exiting
prevention: flagged when price is up over 20 percent and liquidity change is negative

trigger: a few wallets passing the token between themselves
detection: price_without_holders soft risk at 0.75
impact: fake momentum
prevention: flagged when price is up over 30 percent and holder change is not positive

trigger: decision made and acted on later
detection: intent carries an explicit expiry checked at signing
impact: filling on a price that no longer exists
prevention: the signer refuses an expired intent regardless of policy
retry_policy: not retried with the same intent

trigger: transaction built too early or sent too late
detection: lastValidBlockHeight compared against the current block height
impact: a signed transaction silently never lands
prevention: expiry is declared only once the height provably passed
recovery: attempt is marked expired and the intent may be re-derived
retry_policy: new blockhash and a new intent

trigger: RPC fails the height query
detection: the attempt is left unresolved rather than declared expired
impact: declaring a live transaction dead would double-spend
prevention: expiry requires a positive proof; absence of proof leaves it outstanding
recovery: resolveOutstanding retries on the next pass

trigger: router quote has a validity window
detection: quote timestamps are recorded and the intent expiry is derived from them
impact: executing against a withdrawn price
prevention: intent expiry is the binding deadline

trigger: transaction requires a co-signer
detection: the signer refuses any transaction needing a second signature
impact: a half-signed transaction is submitted or a third party gains control
prevention: required signer count must be exactly one

trigger: the provider returns different bytes than the quote implies
detection: binding check ties the transaction to the intent it claims to execute
impact: signing an attacker-supplied transaction
prevention: the signer never accepts arbitrary serialized transactions; policy binding and effect are all evaluated before signing

trigger: transaction writes an account nobody authorised
detection: policy inspects every account and program in the message
impact: arbitrary state change under our signature
prevention: every program must be on the allowlist

trigger: ALT contents differ from what was decoded
detection: decodeTransaction resolves lookup tables as a structure it understands and fails closed on anything else
impact: accounts resolve to something other than what was reviewed
prevention: undecodable transactions are refused rather than passed through

trigger: preflight reports the transaction would fail
detection: simulation result checked before send
impact: wasted fee and a false expectation of a fill
prevention: simulate before send
retry_policy: not retried with the same blockhash

trigger: state changed between simulate and send
detection: realised balance change compared against the modelled effect
impact: the fill differs from what was authorised
prevention: the effect check bounds lamport outflow before signing

trigger: ATA not yet created for the mint
detection: the transaction includes ATA creation and the rent is charged into the cost model
impact: the transaction fails or rent is unaccounted
prevention: rent is included in roundTripCostLamports

failure: insufficient SOL for rent or fees
trigger: balance drawn down by open positions
detection: the SOL reserve is subtracted before any size is computed
impact: a transaction fails after the decision was made
prevention: sizePosition never spends into the configured reserve
recovery: size is zero and no intent is created

trigger: price moved past the minimum-out floor
detection: the transaction reverts on chain
impact: no fill and a lost fee
prevention: minOutWithSlippage bounds the acceptable output
recovery: attempt recorded as failed; the intent may be re-derived

trigger: leader never included it
detection: no status for the signature and the blockhash eventually expires
impact: capital state is unknown
prevention: every send is recorded before it is attempted
recovery: resolveOutstanding declares it expired only after the height passes
retry_policy: re-derive rather than resend the same bytes

trigger: retry after an ambiguous send
detection: idempotency key claimed exactly once per decision
impact: the same position entered twice
prevention: the key is claimed in the same transaction that creates the intent
recovery: the duplicate returns without touching the signer or the network

trigger: send threw after the bytes may have reached the wire
detection: treated as unknown rather than failed
impact: a landed transaction recorded as never sent
prevention: a send that threw leaves the attempt outstanding
recovery: the chain is queried on the next pass

trigger: the process never saw the send return but the transaction landed
detection: recovery reads the truth off the chain
impact: an open position invisible to the engine
prevention: state is reconstructed from chain signatures not from process memory
recovery: recorded as confirmed on the next resolve pass

trigger: a landed transaction that reverted
detection: the transaction meta error field is checked not merely its presence
impact: a revert recorded as a fill
prevention: landed-but-reverted is recorded as failed

failure: RPC says failed while the provider says success
trigger: two sources disagree
detection: chain status is authoritative
impact: acting on the wrong belief
prevention: only the chain is consulted for finality

failure: provider reports success before the balance changed
trigger: optimistic provider response
detection: realised balance is read and compared
impact: phantom fill
prevention: a fill is recorded from the on-chain effect not from a provider acknowledgement

trigger: ledger and chain disagree
detection: reconcile compares stored positions against chain balances
impact: trading on a wrong view of capital
prevention: reconciliation is run on startup and on demand

trigger: priority fee higher than authorised
detection: policy caps the priority fee and the ceiling comes from the intent itself
impact: paying an unbounded fee
prevention: the signer takes its ceiling from the intent so the two cannot disagree

failure: fee payer is not our key
trigger: crafted or mistaken transaction
detection: policy compares the fee payer against the configured key
impact: paying for someone else's transaction
prevention: fee payer must equal our public key

trigger: route too complex for one packet
detection: size is checked against MAX_TX_BYTES
impact: the transaction is rejected by the network after fees are committed
prevention: refuse above 1232 bytes before signing

trigger: truncation trailing bytes or an unsupported version
detection: decodeTransaction rejects each case explicitly
impact: signing bytes nobody has read
prevention: fail closed on anything the decoder cannot fully account for

trigger: the only exit venue disappears
detection: exit quote fails at exit time
impact: capital stranded in an open position
prevention: exits re-quote rather than assuming a route

trigger: orphaned write
detection: foreign key refuses an attempt with no parent intent
impact: an execution record with no decision behind it
prevention: referential integrity is enforced in the schema

trigger: replay of a send path
detection: unique constraint on the signature
impact: double counting a single on-chain event
prevention: uniqueness enforced in the schema

trigger: optimistic local state change
detection: a SUBMITTED attempt stays outstanding until the chain answers
impact: believing a live transaction is dead
prevention: state transitions out of SUBMITTED require chain evidence

trigger: a failure while resolving a batch
detection: each outstanding attempt is resolved independently
impact: unresolved capital hidden behind one error
prevention: per-attempt error isolation in the resolve loop

trigger: malformed instruction data
detection: the effect check refuses rather than assuming zero outflow
impact: an unbounded outflow treated as bounded
prevention: fail closed on any transfer it cannot parse

trigger: a feature computed from data later than the decision
detection: every decision is re-derived from a snapshot captured at decision time
impact: backtest results that cannot be realised
prevention: the snapshot is the only input replay is permitted to read
recovery: divergence is reported as a defect

failure: snapshot does not capture everything the decision read
trigger: a gate reads a value not stored
detection: replay diverges from the stored verdict
impact: a backtest built on incomplete snapshots is fiction
prevention: replay compares eligibility scores and vetoes field by field
recovery: divergence fails the run with a non-zero exit code

trigger: corpus empty or all rows at another strategy version
detection: replayed count is checked and zero is treated as a failure
impact: zero divergences over zero rows read as success
prevention: exit code 1 when nothing was actually verified
recovery: operator is told nothing was verified

trigger: comparison logic broken
detection: tests prove the checker catches a flipped verdict an altered score an invented veto and a missing quote
impact: undetectable regression in the safety net
prevention: both directions are tested - clean corpus reproduces and tampered corpus is caught

trigger: strategy version bumped
detection: rows at another strategy_version are counted separately and never compared
impact: a version bump reported as a determinism failure
prevention: scoping by strategy_version

trigger: only successful tokens stored
detection: every screened token is stored including every rejection
impact: filters cannot be evaluated because their rejects are invisible
prevention: rejects are the product; a screening row is written for every screened token

trigger: the outcome influences a feature
detection: features are computed before the outcome exists
impact: inflated backtest accuracy
prevention: decision-time snapshot separation

trigger: the candidate set is chosen with hindsight
detection: candidates are banked at discovery not selected later
impact: the backtest trades tokens nobody could have known about
prevention: discovery order is preserved in the candidates table

trigger: provider back-fills a field after the fact
detection: replay reconstructs the provider object from the snapshot not from a re-fetch
impact: decisions evaluated against data that did not exist yet
prevention: createdAt is derived from the recorded age rather than re-fetched

failure: selection bias from a broken enrichment stub
trigger: test double returns an empty set
detection: screening counts asserted against a positive lower bound
impact: every assertion passes vacuously
prevention: tests assert that the thing under test actually ran

trigger: positions still open at the end of the sample
detection: not yet handled
impact: truncated outcomes bias the return distribution
prevention: intended: report open positions separately from closed ones

trigger: winners are rare
detection: not yet handled
impact: a model that predicts the majority class scores well and is useless
prevention: intended: report base rates alongside any accuracy figure

trigger: tuning thresholds on the observed corpus
detection: not yet controlled
impact: thresholds that describe the past and not the future
prevention: intended: hold out a period and record every tuning decision in the multiple-testing ledger

trigger: many thresholds tried until one works
detection: every configuration change is logged with the sample it was chosen on
impact: a spurious result reported as a finding
prevention: the multiple-testing ledger records every hypothesis tried

trigger: overlapping windows treated as independent
detection: not yet handled
impact: confidence intervals far too narrow
prevention: intended: block bootstrap over non-overlapping windows

trigger: the market regime changes
detection: strategy_version scoping isolates each generation of the strategy
impact: pooling incomparable periods
prevention: decisions are versioned and compared within a version

trigger: the population that passes the gates changes over time
detection: eligibility rate over time is recorded
impact: the strategy quietly stops trading or starts trading something else
prevention: every screening is timestamped

trigger: a provider field changes meaning or availability
detection: absence rates are recorded per field as soft-risk reasons
impact: a gate silently becomes a no-op
prevention: unavailability is an explicit named reason not a silent default

failure: a scoring term that is structurally always zero
trigger: the term reads a field that is never populated in the traded window
detection: measured directly against the corpus
impact: a weighted term contributes nothing while appearing to
prevention: measurement before trust

trigger: the same mint in both splits
detection: not yet handled
impact: leakage across splits
prevention: intended: split by mint and by creator

trigger: the same creator in both splits
detection: not yet handled
impact: correlated outcomes counted as independent evidence
prevention: intended: group splits by creator cluster

trigger: assuming the quoted price is achieved
detection: paper mode simulates latency fees and failure
impact: paper results that live can never reproduce
prevention: fills are simulated against a live executable quote

trigger: only counting fills
detection: failed attempts are stored as first-class rows
impact: cost understated and landing rate overstated

trigger: one outlier carries the result
detection: not yet reported
impact: a strategy that is one lucky trade
prevention: intended: report the result with the top winner removed

trigger: no comparison to holding SOL
detection: not yet reported
impact: a positive number that underperforms doing nothing
prevention: intended: benchmark every period against SOL

trigger: hour-of-day rules fitted to the sample
detection: ledger records any time filter as a hypothesis
impact: a filter that describes noise

failure: a false property test that never terminates
trigger: a property that is not actually true
detection: fast-check global interrupt limit with markInterruptAsFailure

prevention: property search and shrink is bounded inside fast-check where the timer can fire

failure: silent precision loss in a loss measure
trigger: integer truncation below the resolution floor
detection: measured and documented on the function itself
impact: a zero read as no change when a change occurred
prevention: the floor is documented and callers are told to compare bigints for equality

trigger: unhandled exception
detection: the process exits and the lock heartbeat stops
impact: open positions unattended
prevention: state is durable in SQLite and reconstructed on restart

trigger: an await without a catch
detection: process exits non-zero
impact: silent data loss
prevention: provider calls are wrapped and converted into typed failures

trigger: unbounded in-process accumulation
detection: RSS growth over a long run

trigger: a long synchronous computation

failure: stale test processes exhaust host memory

trigger: log and database growth
detection: not detected
impact: writes fail and the ledger is truncated mid-transaction
prevention: intended: doctor checks free space and refuses below a floor

trigger: unclean shutdown or hardware fault
detection: integrity check at open
impact: decisions written against a corrupt ledger
prevention: WAL journal mode

trigger: two writers on one database
detection: SQLite busy errors
impact: writes lost or delayed
prevention: WAL mode plus a single writer process enforced by the process lock

trigger: operator starts a second engine
detection: ProcessLock compares pid and heartbeat

trigger: previous holder crashed

trigger: host suspends with a position open

trigger: power loss or update
detection: the lock heartbeat stops and the process is gone
impact: open positions unattended until restart

trigger: code changed while capital is at risk
detection: strategy_version recorded on every decision
impact: decisions before and after are silently pooled
prevention: version is part of every screening row

trigger: per-token logging at scale
detection: log volume
impact: disk exhaustion and unreadable logs
prevention: structured logging at a level that is configurable

failure: a bug in a test double read as a production defect
trigger: stub returns a shape the real client never returns
detection: the real client signature was checked against the stub
impact: time spent debugging code that was correct
prevention: test doubles are written against the real return type

trigger: pre-migration copy is not a consistent WAL snapshot and its failure path is an empty catch
detection: not detected
impact: partial or total loss of the decision corpus
prevention: openDb copies the db file to <path>.bak on every non-readonly open
recovery: restore from .bak accepting loss of any transaction still in the WAL

trigger: scanner locks or removes the database file
detection: SQLite open failure
impact: the engine cannot start or loses data
prevention: documented exclusion for the data directory

trigger: a server bound to a public interface
detection: no dashboard exists; the empty package and its script were removed
impact: remote control of the trading process
prevention: there is no HTTP server in the tree

trigger: SIGINT during a write
detection: transactional writes
impact: a partially written decision
prevention: every multi-row write is a single SQLite transaction

failure: kill switch does not stop new entries
trigger: operator invokes kill and the engine keeps trading
detection: kill writes a durable flag the engine reads
impact: capital committed after an explicit stop
prevention: the flag is persisted rather than signalled in memory

failure: an inline environment assignment silently does nothing
trigger: MODE=paper prefixed to a package script under cmd.exe
detection: observed - the script ran as observe and the entry point refused to start
impact: running a mode nobody selected or refusing to start for no visible reason
prevention: the mode is passed as an explicit argument and parsed by modeFromArgv

trigger: doctor loads the default config regardless of the mode about to be run
detection: doctor takes no mode argument
impact: preflight passes against observe limits before a live run
prevention: intended: doctor accepts the same mode argument the engine will use

failure: reconcile runs without the process lock
trigger: operator reconciles while the engine is live
detection: not detected
impact: two writers mutating position state
prevention: intended: reconcile acquires the same engine lock

failure: config declares one mode and the command line another
trigger: mismatched config file
detection: loadConfig refuses a config whose declared mode differs from the requested one
impact: running live with a canary's risk limits
prevention: the mismatch is a startup failure

failure: bigint silently narrowed by the database
trigger: SQLite INTEGER is 64-bit signed
detection: amounts are persisted as TEXT and parsed back as bigint
impact: a raw amount above 2^63 wraps negative
prevention: every token amount column is TEXT

trigger: snapshot write fails after the screening write
detection: orphan count asserted to be zero after a full cycle
impact: a decision that can never be re-derived
prevention: both rows are written in one transaction

trigger: a key pasted into a tracked file
detection: secretscan over the working tree
impact: total loss of funds
prevention: .env is git-ignored and doctor verifies that it is

trigger: logging an object containing a key
detection: logger redaction and no secret is ever passed to a log call
impact: key disclosure through log shipping or screenshots
prevention: secrets are read at startup and never placed on a logged object

failure: secret in shell history or process arguments
trigger: a key passed as a CLI flag
detection: no secret is accepted as a command-line argument
impact: disclosure through history files and the process table
prevention: secrets come only from the environment or a file

trigger: a transitive package ships hostile code
detection: lockfile pinning and a deliberately small dependency set
impact: arbitrary code with access to the keypair
prevention: four runtime dependencies total and no install scripts from unknown publishers

trigger: a near-miss package name
detection: manual review of every added dependency
impact: arbitrary code execution
prevention: dependencies are added deliberately and reviewed

trigger: a trusted package is hijacked upstream
detection: lockfile pins exact resolutions
impact: arbitrary code execution on install
prevention: pnpm-lock.yaml is committed and installs are frozen

trigger: a hostile or compromised endpoint returns crafted data
detection: every decoded structure fails closed on anything unexpected
impact: acting on fabricated chain state
prevention: decoders validate rather than trust; the signer never accepts provider-supplied bytes unchecked

trigger: any path that signs bytes it did not verify
detection: the signer evaluates policy binding and effect before every signature
impact: total loss of funds
prevention: the signer refuses to sign anything that fails any of the three checks

trigger: secret and public halves disagree
detection: the loader verifies the public half against the secret half
impact: signing with a key that is not the one configured
prevention: verification at load

trigger: truncated or padded file
detection: length is checked at load
impact: undefined signing behaviour
prevention: exactly 64 bytes required

failure: signer available in a mode that must not trade
trigger: configuration or code change
detection: signerAllowed is false for observe and paper by construction
impact: an unattended mode taking a position
prevention: observe and paper never import the execution package

failure: capital-bearing tables written in observe mode
trigger: an accidental write path
detection: intents execution_attempts positions and fills asserted empty after a full observe cycle
impact: silent trading from a mode that promises not to
prevention: the assertion is made against the database not against the code path

trigger: a filename derived from external input
detection: no external value is ever used to build a path
impact: arbitrary file read or write
prevention: paths come from configuration only

trigger: external text interpolated into a statement
detection: every statement is prepared with bound parameters
impact: arbitrary database access
prevention: no string concatenation builds a query with external data

trigger: external text passed to a shell
detection: no shell command is constructed from external data anywhere in the tree
impact: arbitrary command execution
prevention: the runtime never spawns a shell with interpolated data

trigger: a metadata URI pointing at an internal address
detection: metadata URIs are never fetched
impact: internal network probing from our host
prevention: no code path dereferences a token-supplied URL

trigger: an alert body includes configuration
detection: no alert channel is configured
impact: disclosure to a third-party service
prevention: nothing is sent off host

trigger: token name or description crafted as an instruction
detection: no model reads any external content at runtime
impact: the system is steered by an attacker
prevention: no LLM exists in the hot path

failure: live mode started without an explicit acknowledgement
trigger: operator runs live
detection: evaluateGates requires an acknowledgement file outside the repository
impact: real funds committed without a deliberate human act
prevention: the gate can never all-pass without the file

trigger: operator promotes to canary early
detection: gates name each missing observation with what was seen and what was required
impact: capital committed on an untested strategy
prevention: every failing gate carries both observed and required

trigger: a configuration edit
detection: doctor checks that a single entry cannot exceed the total exposure cap
impact: unbounded loss
prevention: cross-field validation at load

failure: gate evidence claims more than it measures
trigger: a gate advertises a property it does not check
detection: identified by inspection - the replay corpus gate counts snapshots and does not persist a replay result
impact: an operator trusts a verification that never ran
prevention: gates must measure what they name

failure: exit reason conflates cost drift with liquidity collapse
trigger: paper.ts:360 passes Math.abs(priceImpactPct) so a -9914bps pool collapse and a +519bps cost drift both record exit_cost_exploded
detection: not detected - both events produce an identical reason string
impact: post-hoc analysis attributes total losses to a miscalibrated cost cap and tunes the wrong parameter
prevention: none - the abs is applied before the rule sees the value
recovery: separate the signed collapse case into its own exit reason
metric_alert: share of exits whose recorded reason matches the event that caused them

failure: favourable price impact triggers an exit
trigger: the same Math.abs at paper.ts:360 means a large favourable impact reading exceeds maxExitImpactBps and forces a sale
detection: not detected
impact: positions closed for moving in our favour
prevention: none
recovery: preserve the sign of priceImpactPct at the call site
metric_alert: count of exits where impact was favourable and the position was still closed

failure: a configured secret is loaded and consumed by nothing
trigger: HELIUS_API_KEY was read by loadSecrets and never used by any caller
detection: found by grepping the symbol - doctor reported the key as present so nothing surfaced it
impact: an operator believes on-chain reads are configured while no RPC endpoint exists; A5 top-holder measurement silently never runs
prevention: loadSecrets derives rpcHttp from the key when SOLANA_RPC_HTTP is unset and records which source won

failure: a rate bucket configured at exactly the documented ceiling
trigger: jupiter_main withKeyRequestsPerSecond was 1.0 against a documented 1 rps free keyed tier
detection: never exercised - the keyed branch was unreachable until a key existed
impact: sustained 429s and a provider-side ban rather than a slowdown; breaches the strictly-under rule this file states in _meta
prevention: lowered to 0.8 preserving the 0.8x headroom ratio the keyless bucket already used

failure: a live credential embedded in a URL reaches a log
trigger: Helius authenticates by query parameter so the key is part of the endpoint string
detection: scrubSecrets api-key rule plus the helius_url_with_key secretscan rule
impact: the RPC key is disclosed in a log file or a committed artefact
prevention: the URL is assembled in one function and never written to disk; redaction asserted against an interpolated error message

failure: a secrets file is documented and guarded by every mechanism except the one that reads it
trigger: .env was documented in ENVIRONMENT.md git-ignored secretscan-guarded and doctor-checked while no code path ever read it
detection: found only when a correctly-populated .env produced a doctor run reporting no keys
impact: every secret must arrive as an ambient variable while a populated .env sits inert and every surrounding mechanism reports it as configured
prevention: loadSecrets calls loadDotEnvOnce so every entry point loads it; ambient variables still win and a malformed line is a hard error

failure: an economic outcome derived from an undocumented provider sign convention
trigger: decideExit classified exits on Math.abs(priceImpactPct) so a favourable +0.0911 became 911bps of exit cost
detection: found by reading stored quotes after 8 of the first 10 paper positions closed under one label
impact: a winning position up 2.07% was ejected after 21s while a genuine collapse to 13 lamports got the same label; the aggregate over that label describes nothing
prevention: classification uses executable sell output against entry cost; priceImpactPct is stored raw and signed as evidence and never defines an outcome
recovery: reclassify history via the migration 5 backfill

failure: a profit-taking rule that no input can satisfy
trigger: decideExit measured gain with lossBps(mark, cost) which is POSITIVE when the position is winning then required -up >= takeProfitBps
detection: found by writing a boundary test for take_profit; the expectation failed and the rule not the test turned out to be wrong
impact: take_profit was unreachable for every input across the entire life of the system; winners could only leave via the trailing stop after giving back 3000bps. Position 39bb459b was up more than 6000bps at mark 13 and exited at mark 19 for -0.007073668 SOL; the counterfactual over its own stored marks closes it at +0.033411329 SOL
prevention: gain is measured against cost with lossBps(cost, mark); a reachability test asserts some input produces take_profit and two boundary tests pin the direction
recovery: reclassification is not needed - no historical row claimed a take profit
metric_alert: count of take_profit exits over closed positions; a run of 50+ closed positions with zero is a defect signal

failure: unit tests silently read the operator's real .env and assert about the developer's disk
trigger: closing O031 made loadSecrets call loadDotEnvOnce so tests/unit/secrets.test.ts inherited a live HELIUS_API_KEY
detection: the suite went green on a clean checkout and red on any configured machine
impact: a test that only passes before the system is configured reports the state of a developer's disk rather than the state of the code; its failure diff also printed a real secret
prevention: tests/setup.ts calls suppressDotEnvForTests() so the file is never read during a test run and the secret never enters process.env

failure: replay reports success-shaped output while verifying nothing after a strategy version bump
trigger: bumping strategyVersion to v0.3.0 made all 2000 stored snapshots skip as other-version; divergent count 0 with nothing replayed
detection: noticed because the exit code was the only difference between that run and a real pass
impact: the one moment a bump most needs verification is the moment verification switches itself off; an unnoticed entry-path regression would ship
prevention: --as-version= replays older snapshots against current code; 2000 of 2000 reproduced exactly across the v0.2.0 to v0.3.0 bump
metric_alert: replayed count must be non-zero for a replay run to be treated as evidence

failure: positions marked against the slippage floor rather than the router's expected output
trigger: paper.ts marked at otherAmountThreshold - priorityFee; otherAmountThreshold is derived from our own slippageBps and is not an observation
detection: found while writing position_marks and needing to say what a mark actually measures
impact: every position looked worse by exactly slippageBps at every mark, biasing the stop loss and trailing stop toward early exits and making the mark series unusable as liquidity evidence
prevention: marks record outAmount as the value and otherAmountThreshold alongside it as a separate column
recovery: the 150 backfilled marks were reconstructed from stored quotes using outAmount
metric_alert: exit_value_ratio distribution should not cluster just under 1 minus slippageBps

failure: the daily loss cap is permanent, not daily, and halts the engine indefinitely
trigger: Ledger.dayStartUtcMs was assigned once in restoreLedger and read by nothing; realizedTodayLamports therefore accumulated from process start and never released at midnight UTC
detection: found by asking why pnpm status showed 145 eligible candidates and 0 open positions; sizePosition was refusing every entry with daily_loss_cap against -0.248 SOL realised on earlier days
impact: paper mode stopped opening positions for the entire first measurement window and continued to look healthy - it screened, scored and logged normally. Zero closed trades were added to the sample while the process reported itself live. A cap that never releases is indistinguishable from a hang
prevention: rollDayIfNeeded is called every cycle before any entry work and recomputes realizedTodayLamports from the database for the new UTC day; the cap value itself is unchanged
recovery: no data to repair - no trade was taken or mispriced, the engine simply refused to act
metric_alert: an engine reporting eligible candidates with zero open positions for more than one discovery interval, while below maxSimultaneousPositions, is a defect signal

failure: realised P&L summed through a double, defeating the reason the column is TEXT
trigger: restoreLedger used SUM(CAST(realized_lamports AS INTEGER)) and read the result as a JS number before passing it to BigInt()
detection: found while extracting the ledger helpers into a testable module
impact: amounts above 2^53 silently lose precision and any non-integral sum makes the subsequent BigInt() throw. Paper NAV is far below that today, so this had not yet produced a wrong number - it was a latent violation of the bigint invariant sitting in the NAV path
prevention: sumRealized selects the TEXT values and accumulates in bigint; a test sums 2^53+1 across two rows and asserts the double answer is wrong
recovery: n/a - no stored value was affected
metric_alert: none; the property is enforced by test rather than by monitoring

failure: the resolution of the entire exit corpus was set by the discovery budget
trigger: the paper loop had one interval; open positions were re-quoted only when discovery ran, so the mark cadence was discoveryIntervalMs - about 31s as measured
detection: found in P1 while attributing losses: every one of the four liquidity collapses did all of its damage inside a single mark interval
impact: the corpus cannot distinguish a one-block rug from a 25-second drain, so it cannot say whether any prospective exit signal existed. This is an instrument limitation and it blocks the central question of P2, not a market finding
prevention: markIntervalMs is a separate config field defaulting to 10s; the loop ticks at the mark cadence and discovery gates itself on its own longer interval. Paper maxSimultaneousPositions is 1 during the measurement phase so exit monitoring is never starved by candidate scanning
recovery: the 150 existing marks keep their ~31s spacing and are labelled as such; they are not reinterpreted at the finer resolution
metric_alert: observed spacing between consecutive position_marks rows exceeding 2x markIntervalMs

failure: three declared risk halts are enforced by nothing
trigger: maxAggregatePlannedLossPct, dailyLossHaltPct and weeklyLossHaltPct appear in RiskConfigSchema and in SAFER_WHEN_LOWER and are read by no enforcement code; drawdownHaltPct was the fourth until this change
detection: found by grepping the four risk-halt field names across the tree while investigating why paper mode had stopped entering positions
impact: the tree carried machinery to refuse any override that loosened four caps, three of which do not exist. An operator reading config/live.json would reasonably believe a 1.5 percent daily loss halt and a 4 percent weekly halt were active. Neither is. In paper this costs nothing because paper cannot spend; in canary or live it is a false guarantee about real money
prevention: drawdownHaltPct is now enforced in sizePosition as the drawdown_halt refusal. The remaining three are a named blocker on canary promotion rather than an open question - see docs/READINESS.md
recovery: no data to repair; no trade was mispriced. The halts simply never fired
metric_alert: a config field name that appears in the schema but in no other module is the signal; the same class produced O028, O031, O037 and the old maxExitImpactBps knob

failure: a documented safety guarantee about risk overrides that no code provides
trigger: the header comment in config.ts stated that assertNotLoosened enforces at load time that caps can be tightened but never loosened; assertNotLoosened is exported and never called, and loadConfig merges no env or CLI values into risk at all
detection: found by grepping for the caller of assertNotLoosened while deciding whether editing a risk value in config/paper.json would be refused
impact: harmless today precisely because the override path it guards does not exist. It becomes a live defect the moment anyone adds one, because the comment tells that person the check is already wired
prevention: the comment now says the rule is enforced by the absence of an override path and that any change adding one must call assertNotLoosened in the same commit
test_fixture: none yet - a test asserting that loadConfig ignores a risk env var would pin it

failure: decisions were not re-derivable from their snapshots because an input the gates saw was never written to the row
trigger: finalizeScreen evaluated the concentration gate against an on-chain holder distribution and stored none of it; replayOne passed null and carried a comment claiming the caller excluded rows that had a measurement, while replayAll filtered on strategy_version and nothing else
detection: replay at v0.3.0 reported 28 divergent snapshots out of 1012 - opportunityScore and softRiskScore on all 28, hardVetoes on 4 where a stored concentrated_ownership veto could not be reproduced. Invisible until then because the v0.3.0 bump had made replay skip every row (O035), and invisible before that because concentration was not yet being measured
impact: violates the core invariant that every decision is re-derivable from its snapshot. Any backtest or counterfactual built on those rows would have silently used a different soft-risk mean than the live decision did, and 4 rows would have lost a hard veto entirely. It also made the replay exit code meaningless as a P8 gate
prevention: the measurement is written into rawInputs.concentration. A MISSING key means the row predates capture and is now counted as unverifiable and reported by the CLI, never as a pass; a null value means measured-and-unavailable and replays exactly. replayable() fails closed on an unparseable row so corruption is still reported as a divergence
recovery: the 34 pre-capture rows cannot be repaired - the data was never collected. They are excluded and counted, not reinterpreted
metric_alert: replay unverifiable count must be zero for any corpus used as evidence; a nonzero value is a capture gap, not a rounding detail

failure: a simulation setup that does not describe the leg
trigger: simulateObservation funds every request with SOL whatever the transaction spends
detection: 43 of 43 sells fail with an identical error at an identical instruction index across every venue and size
impact: every sell is recorded as a route failure; the exit half of every round trip appears impossible
prevention: validateSetup() refuses a zero amount, a sell with no token program, a sell whose input is SOL, and a same-asset leg BEFORE the request is sent
recovery: the window is labelled INSTRUMENT_DEVELOPMENT and excluded from every aggregate
retry_policy: no retry: an invalid setup is a caller defect and running it records a caller defect as a simulation outcome

failure: runtime success read as economic success
trigger: a Solana runtime returns no transaction error for a swap that delivered nothing
detection: SIMULATED_EFFECT_OK refuses on a zero output delta; the daemon bounds check agrees independently
impact: a swap that charged the fee and delivered nothing is booked as a working leg and a filled position
prevention: four separate checks composed: RUNTIME_OK EFFECT_OK FEE_DECOMPOSITION_OK ACCOUNT_COVERAGE_OK
recovery: legIsExecutable refuses the leg; the position is not opened
retry_policy: none: the refusal is the outcome

failure: a gate that can never pass
trigger: the unexpected-movement check refused whenever any account gained lamports, which every AMM swap does
detection: zero of ten valid-window jobs could pass regardless of what the trade did
impact: the composite verdict is unreachable, so everything downstream routes around it
prevention: the check refuses only against a stated model of expected recipients; the movement is measured and persisted either way
recovery: narrowed with a reason; the other three checks still decide the verdict

failure: two loss models inside one aggregate cap
trigger: a proposed trade is charged the catastrophic floor while existing positions are charged the nominal stop
detection: an existing and an identical proposed position produce different planned-loss numbers
impact: the aggregate cap reads the open book as four times safer than the model says it is
prevention: both sides call plannedLossFractionBps()
recovery: the cap binds at the level it was configured to bind at
metric_alert: compare plannedLossLamports against notional times the floor

failure: soft risk diluted by a reassuring feature
trigger: the aggregation is the mean, so adding a gate that reports no risk divides the same total by a larger count
detection: one 0.9 risk plus one 0.0 risk scores 0.45
impact: a dangerous token becomes safer every time the system learns something reassuring about it
prevention: max(primary) + bounded secondary: the worst single risk is a floor nothing can lower
recovery: the score reflects the risks actually found
metric_alert: summarize() output against a single-gate baseline

failure: a missing net-buyer count replaced with gross buys
trigger: the provider omits numNetBuyers and the gate substitutes numBuys
detection: the anti-wash gate passes on a token whose net buyers are unknown
impact: wash trading satisfies the gate designed to detect it, precisely when the honest number is unavailable
prevention: no substitution: absence is charged as soft risk and the veto is not evaluated
recovery: the token is screened on the evidence that exists
metric_alert: gate net_buyers_unavailable appears in the screening row

failure: cleanup ordered before custom post-swap instructions
trigger: otherInstructions are appended after cleanupInstruction
detection: an instruction touching the wrapped-SOL account executes after the account is closed
impact: the assembled transaction differs from the one the route describes and the policy validated
prevention: order is compute, setup, swap, other, cleanup, tip
recovery: the transaction executes in the documented order
metric_alert: instruction order in the exact transaction blob

trigger: the schema accepts tipInstruction and the assembler never includes it
detection: a route that requested a tip produces a transaction with no tip instruction
impact: the tip is invisible to the policy decoder, absent from the byte-level hash, and missing from every cost model
prevention: the tip is assembled last and its amount decoded from the System transfer as a bigint
recovery: the cost model sees the tip the route actually asked for
metric_alert: BuildOutcome.hasTip with a null tipLamports means requested but unreadable

failure: a canary gate that passes on losing trades
trigger: the gate counts completed positions and never reads what they earned
detection: 200 impeccably provenanced losing trades satisfy every clause
impact: real capital is committed to a strategy the corpus shows losing money
prevention: readiness gates require net PnL, log growth, its lower bound, profit factor, drawdown and robustness to trade and day removal
recovery: the promotion is refused and every failing gate is named
retry_policy: none: a failed gate is never weakened to make a run possible

failure: a package script pointing at a file that does not exist
trigger: shadow:status referenced scripts/shadow-status.ts, which was never written
detection: ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND on invocation
impact: an operational check that looks available and has never run
prevention: the command is wired to scripts/evidence-status.ts and produces a real artifact
metric_alert: the artifact file exists and carries a recent generatedUtcMs

failure: offline replay cannot restore a multi-program route
trigger: a Pump route invokes six programs whose ELFs must be redeployed, and surfnet_writeProgram drops its RPC connection on a 10.5 MB program; soPath removed the N-API marshalling and the failure was unchanged
detection: SIMULATION_UNKNOWN with detail cheatcode failed: surfnet_writeProgram; /v1/health stops answering during the restore
impact: no Pump fingerprint can reach OFFLINE_REPRODUCIBLE, so CONFIRMATORY is unreachable for the venue carrying 4,545 of 26,515 observations
prevention: the deploy budget refuses a snapshot beyond a measured bound rather than hanging the daemon with nothing to diagnose
recovery: JIT collection is unaffected and continues; the route is capped at JIT_EFFECT_VALID
retry_policy: none: retrying a synchronous deploy that did not finish in five minutes will not finish on the second attempt
metric_alert: artifacts/simulator-parity.json disqualifiers contains the offline replay was SIMULATION_UNKNOWN

failure: a decision-bearing module that nothing calls
trigger: entity.ts and accountwatch.ts are complete and tested and have zero non-test importers; mintfacts.ts left the list when P17 wired it into the screening gate
detection: tests/unit/no-dead-modules.test.ts counts live importers per module
impact: the capability appears to exist in every report that counts files or tests, and decides nothing; P13 on-chain facts and P14 WSS alarms are implemented and inert
prevention: the KNOWN_INERT list can only shrink, and a NEW dead module fails on the day it is written rather than a directive later
recovery: wire the module into the decision path, then delete its KNOWN_INERT entry
metric_alert: the test fails when a listed module gains an importer, which is the signal to remove it from the list

failure: token balances keyed by two different identities at the two ends
trigger: the daemon serialised by token-account pubkey; the effect verifier looked up owner:mint
detection: every stored pre/post token map contains only base58 account pubkeys and no owner:mint key has ever existed
impact: every token delta read as unobserved, so a buy that credited its ATA exactly as intended was refused for missing output; all 20 VALID_DEVELOPMENT jobs EFFECT_REFUSED
prevention: ObservedTokenBalance carries tokenAccount, owner, mint, tokenProgram and amount; one audited aggregation groups by (owner, mint, tokenProgram)
recovery: the window is closed as instrument development and the rows are kept as evidence
retry_policy: none: a lookup that cannot match will not match on a retry
metric_alert: simulation_jobs.token_deltas is empty while a token moved

failure: a mint decoded as a token account
trigger: the token-account decoder checked only that the owner is a token program and the data is at least 72 bytes; a legacy mint is 82
detection: structured output carried balances attributed to owners that do not exist
impact: phantom token balances in every route that names its own mint
prevention: sizes are the discriminator: mint 82, account 165, Token-2022 165 plus a type byte where 1 is Mint and 2 is Account
recovery: refuse the account rather than decode it
metric_alert: a token balance whose owner appears in no instruction

failure: the leg own accounts truncated out of the watch window
trigger: MAX_WATCHED_ACCOUNTS was 64 and the watched list was an unordered slice; a Pump route resolves past 64 through its lookup tables
detection: the pool movement and the fee payer movement are both observed and the taker credit is not
impact: a delivered transaction reported as output delta missing, by both the daemon bounds check and the effect verifier
prevention: the fee payer, each token mutation owner and the derived ATA for each named mint under both programs go first; cap raised to 256
recovery: the run is re-simulated with the leg accounts watched
metric_alert: truncated > 0 on a run intended as evidence

failure: the sell credit has two values
trigger: the effect verifier subtracts provisioning rent from the payer movement and the daemon bounds check does not
detection: daemon reports native SOL credit -1420 where the verifier reports 4146740 for the same leg
impact: a cost that appears in one path and disappears in another; against a 0.02 SOL leg the 2039280 of ATA rent is ten percent of the notional and dominates the answer
prevention: the setup writes the source account byte for byte, rent-exempt, so the payer never funds it and the question does not arise
recovery: neither number is quoted as the answer
metric_alert: compare boundsViolations against the verifier outputCredit on any sell

failure: a websocket pointed at a different provider than HTTP
trigger: SOLANA_RPC_HTTP names one provider while a stale HELIUS_API_KEY is still present, so rpcWs derives from the key
detection: the socket closes with code 1006 on every attempt and every websocket feature silently covers nothing
impact: the live migration lane records a coverage gap that reads as a chain fact rather than a configuration one
prevention: wsUrlFromHttp derives the socket from the endpoint HTTP is actually using; the Helius key is the last fallback, not the first
recovery: the collector prints NO WEBSOCKET when none can be derived, rather than starting a lane that covers nothing
retry_policy: no retry: a socket pointed at the wrong host never connects
metric_alert: wss:status reports open subscriptions per kind and names zero coverage explicitly
test_fixture: tests/unit/live-lane-p8-p13.test.ts the socket follows the endpoint HTTP is actually using

failure: an exhausted DAILY QUOTA read as a fact about the token
trigger: the RPC daily allowance is spent and every getAccountInfo returns HTTP 429
detection: isQuotaExhausted matches the provider message body; a per-second limit and a spent allowance are both 429
impact: every candidate refuses with the pool could not be read and the refusal histogram reads as a chain with no canonical pools
prevention: the pool read failure is carried on the facts and named APPARATUS, apart from a pool that is genuinely not canonical
recovery: the collector STOPS the pass rather than grinding out apparatus refusals for the rest of the cycle
retry_policy: no retry today: backing off on a spent daily allowance is pure waste
metric_alert: rate:budget-v2 names the daily quota as the binding constraint when one is observed
test_fixture: tests/unit/candidate-risk-p10.test.ts an apparatus failure is never reported as a property of the token

failure: unmeasured clustering reported as MEASURED zero
trigger: entityAdjustedConcentration receives an EMPTY holder-history list
detection: the filter for incomplete histories finds nothing in an empty collection, so the verdict is MEASURED with the caller share
impact: a candidate whose holders were never examined passes the concentration gate identically to one measured as unclustered
prevention: an empty history list returns HISTORY_INCOMPLETE; vacuous truth over an empty collection is refused by name
recovery: the caller falls back to the raw balance tier, which is a real measurement, and the stratum records which tier decided

failure: the cashback remaining-account tail compared against the wrong positions
trigger: PumpSwap appends buybackFeeRecipient and its token account after the cashback accounts on every leg
detection: the fail-closed placement check refused every candidate on the chain with CASHBACK_ACCOUNTS_MISPLACED
